dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curvature following a parabolic spline from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a narrow rounded radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximate 50-degree steepness relative to the horizontal body axis along the anterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width approximately 1.5 times the vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Gradual convex arc with a wide radius sloping anteriorly.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak with low longitudinal extension relative to the cranial thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse angle where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small white depigmented mark or lesion visible near the apex on the leading edge of the dorsal fin.
